items.hook: At the Battle of Großbeeren, the Prussians under Von Bülow repulse the French army.
items.body: The Battle of Großbeeren occurred on 23 August 1813 in neighboring Blankenfelde and Sputendorf between the Prussian III Corps under Friedrich von Bülow and the Franco-Saxon VII Corps under Jean Reynier. One of those things you can't un-know.
